raw:
Agent Name: Corporate_Governance_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task by evaluating whether members had ever held C-suite roles rather than whether they were in C-suite positions at the time they joined Apple’s board, and narrowed the scope to five members, omitting others like Al Gore. This misframing led to the final incorrect conclusion in Step 9 that no member fit the criterion, despite at least one (e.g., Al Gore) not holding a corporate C-suite position when appointed.
